name: Sheriff Badge
descriptionTemplate: Hand Limit +1. At battle start, add 1 {derived:derived.global.event-cauldron|Cauldron} to your hand. At turn start, if you hold a {derived:derived.global.event-cauldron|Cauldron}, you may {Exhaust} 1 card from your hand and put it into the {derived:derived.global.event-cauldron|Cauldron}. Once the brewing conditions are met, the {derived:derived.global.event-cauldron|Cauldron} transforms into a {derived:derived.global.event-potion|Potion}.
lore: It may take many more centuries for anyone to figure out: why a story set in a midnight forest under a blood moon—with Witches and Seers—still needs to hold an election for a Sheriff.
